summary: Canadian Natural Resources Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a quarterly cash dividend of C$0.625 per common share, payable October 2, 2026, to shareholders of record September 11, 2026. The filing notes 2026 marks the 26th consecutive year of dividend increases with a 20% CAGR, emphasizing board confidence in the business model and balance sheet. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation, capital return program, or structural event. No deal terms, M&A activity, or strategic review is included. The filing is purely informational and regular in nature.
